title: Component
description: A Component is a discrete, renderable UI element. Components describe what can be rendered, not how it is rendered. Each component has a type, an observable state, and a set of available actions.

componentId.description: Stable kebab-case identifier for this component (e.g. 'product-carousel'). Must be unique within a Catalog.

displayName.description: Human-readable name for this component (e.g. 'Product Carousel').

description.description: Human-readable description of this component's purpose and rendering intent.

componentType.description: Stable kebab-case type identifier (e.g. 'cart'). Used as discriminant for contract resolution.

state.description: The observable state owned by the backend. An empty object {} is valid for components with no observable state.

actions.description: Map of available actions. Each value conforms to base/action.schema.json. An empty object {} is valid for read-only components.
